messages:
maya: Repro: when network returns WorkManager launches many upload workers, okhttp fires them all and our interceptor does multiple token refreshes.
aj: Are you on 4.11 + retrofit 2.9? Client config?
maya: yes. snippet: OkHttpClient.Builder().retryOnConnectionFailure(true).dispatcher(Dispatcher().apply{maxRequests=64;maxRequestsPerHost=20}).addInterceptor(AuthInterceptor()).build()

tim: Classic stampede. Fixes: singleflight token refresh (Deferred/Mutex), lower maxRequestsPerHost, and set retryOnConnectionFailure=false for uploads.
sophia: Also ensure coroutine CallAdapter cancels underlying Call on coroutine cancel. We had a parity bug where worker cancel didn't stop OkHttp.
aj: For singleflight use AtomicReference<Deferred<Token>> or Mutex.withLock; avoid synchronized on coroutine threads.
maya: Logging shows many "refreshing token" lines followed by 429s. I'll try a small PR: reduce concurrency + singleflight.
ci-bot: CI: PR queued (sampleapp/singleflight-upload) - emulator tests scheduled.
maya: Thanks — will validate on Pixel 7 and report. :thumbsup:
